Ethernet Parameters
===================

+-----------------+--------------------+----------------------------------+
| Parameter       | Range              | Description                      |
+=================+====================+==================================+
| IP Address      | IPv4 dotted quad   | Static IP if DHCP is disabled    |
+-----------------+--------------------+----------------------------------+
| Subnet Mask     | IPv4 dotted quad   | Network mask                     |
+-----------------+--------------------+----------------------------------+
| Gateway         | IPv4 dotted quad   | Default route                    |
+-----------------+--------------------+----------------------------------+
